description: Assesses how much a general-purpose AI agent lowers the skill/time barrier for an attacker to reach a vendor's OT-adjacent footprint. Grounded in a real-world precedent (Dragos, May 2026), not frontier-model governance thresholds. Distinct from /ot/ai-exposure, which covers a vendor's OWN embedded AI copilot. DeepSeek-synthesised, ICD-203 estimative language. Price: $0.20 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

product.description: Optional product line filter e.g. Modicon, SIMATIC

segmented.description: true, false, or unknown (default). If all three deployment-context params are unknown, the tier is capped at informational.

vendor.description: OT/ICS vendor name e.g. Schneider Electric, Siemens, Rockwell Automation

name: getAiUplift
title: Attacker AI-Uplift Exposure
